sonnet.problem: Card 7 already asks about Moses' words in verse 6 and its right answer is that the LORD their God goes with them. Card 8 re-asks that same point (the LORD staying with them and not leaving) as a true/false, and the earlier answer gives it away. It is not a new fact.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: Verse 27 says "If you are already rebelling against the LORD while I am still alive…". The card turns the "if" into a fact: "He even points out they're already rebelling against the LORD while he's still alive."
